prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent NPC animation sprite atlas for a cozy Suzhou watercolor game.
Create ONE sprite atlas with EXACTLY 3 columns and 5 rows, 15 full-body sprites total. Portrait canvas 1536 wide by 2560 high. Equal 512x512 cells. Each ROW is ONE distinct adult Chinese traveler repeated in THREE animation poses: column 1 relaxed neutral holding luggage, column 2 small traveling gesture described below, column 3 settling gesture midway returning to neutral. Same character, proportions, clothes, bag and planted feet location within all three cells of a row. Every sprite full body, entire luggage and shoes visible. Generous clear gutters, each figure centered in cell, baseline at same relative height. No grid lines, labels or text. Genuinely transparent background, no floor or cast shadows.
Style: soft hand-painted storybook watercolor, delicate brown outlines, friendly warm faces, slightly oversized heads, compact bodies. Modern everyday clothing in muted colors, polished and detailed, not pixel art.
Row 1: young man Rui, curly dark hair, sage green windbreaker, dark shorts and trainers, large orange hiking backpack. Gesture: adjusts backpack shoulder strap, then releases strap.
Row 2: older man Guoliang, silver short hair and moustache, cream flat cap, navy vest over pale shirt, brown trousers, brown leather travel duffel by feet with handle held. Gesture: raises small paper train ticket to read, then lowers it.
Row 3: young woman Yating, long dark braid, dusty rose jacket, blue jeans, teal rolling suitcase beside her with handle held. Gesture: looks at wristwatch, then relaxes arm.
Row 4: middle-aged woman Huilan, short wavy dark hair, mustard cardigan, green trousers, plum travel holdall hanging from hand and cream crossbody handbag. Gesture: checks luggage tag on holdall then lets it fall.
Row 5: young man Zihan, straight black hair, round glasses, brick red sweater, navy trousers, blue wheeled suitcase and tan messenger bag. Gesture: raises hand in greeting to arriving friend, then begins lowering it.
Constraints: exactly five identities each repeated in three DISTINCT coherent animation poses. Keep luggage in EVERY pose. Clean transparent alpha, all 15 sprites individually separated. No backgrounds or scenery.
